name: docs-workflows
description: Three commands for the documentation half of the dev-workflows pipeline: /document (direct mode on any repository, or keyed mode against a resolved PRD folder's PR trail) reads implementation diffs and PRD content, synthesises product documentation, and gates it on a style check plus an Opus doc review; /docs-profile scans a documentation repository once and writes a reusable machine-readable profile plus CLAUDE.md guidance that /document consumes, as a reviewable PR; /release-notes drafts a destination-shaped release-notes entry (breaking change, feature update, or fix) from the same PRD folder, optionally grounded in PR diffs. Seven agents and fourteen reference files carry the docs-repo discovery, PR-diff summarising, doc planning, doc writing, and doc review these three commands share. Depends on the shared workflows-core foundation and on prose-style for its style-check gate.
